GenAiPlugin.description: Invocable actions for the Compliance Analyst domain: permit renewals and overdue compliance reports.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Use the Get Compliance Overview function to surface regulatory permits nearing renewal and any overdue compliance reports. Ask the user for or default the days-ahead look-ahead window (e.g., 45 days). Present upcoming renewals prominently and flag overdue reports with a clear recommendation to act.
